app.name: XiaoBaiSwitch Plus

sites.title: Upstream Sites
sites.emptyDesc: Add your first upstream API site, then apply it to Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or Prime.
sites.name: Display name
sites.baseUrlDefaultHint: The first item is the current / default route
sites.routeSwitchHint: This will update the API URLs already written to Claude Code / Codex / Pi / Prime. Choose "Skip apply" to change only this site’s current route.
sites.routeSwitchSuccess: Route switched and applied API URLs updated
sites.routeSwitchPartial: Route switched; some targets failed to update
sites.routeSwitchSkipped: Route switched without updating applied tools
sites.apiKeyKeepHint: The complete key is loaded; use the eye to reveal it or overwrite it to replace
sites.apiKeyCreateHint: Add multiple keys now; the first one becomes the current key
sites.apiKeyLoadFailed: Could not load the saved key
sites.keySwitchHint: This will refresh models for the selected key. If the site is already applied to Claude Code / Codex / Pi / Prime, you can also sync the key written to those tools.
sites.keySwitchSkip: Switch site and refresh models only
sites.keySwitchSuccess: API key switched and applied tools updated
sites.keySwitchPartial: API key switched; some tools failed to sync or are incompatible
sites.keySwitchSkipped: API key switched without updating applied tools
sites.keySwitchFetchFailed: API key switched, model refresh failed, targets were not synced
sites.quotaUnsupported: This site does not support automatic quota lookup
sites.quotaUnauthorized: Quota authentication failed; check the API key
sites.quotaError: Could not refresh quota; try again
sites.quotaTimeout: Quota request timed out; try again
sites.quotaUpstreamError: The upstream quota service is unavailable; try again
sites.quotaInvalidData: Quota data is invalid and cannot be displayed reliably
sites.quotaLastSuccessRefreshFailed: Showing the last successful quota; refresh failed
sites.protocolHint: Leave empty if unsure, then click 'Test connection' to auto-detect
sites.protocolTestingSlow: The site is slow to respond; still waiting…
sites.protocolTestCancelled: Stopped waiting (the check still finishes in the background)
sites.protocolTestUnauthorized: Authentication rejected: check that the API key matches this site
sites.protocolTestUnreachable: Cannot reach the site: network error or request timeout
sites.protocolTestEndpointUnrecognized: The site responded, but no recognizable models endpoint was found
sites.baseUrlRequired: Please fill in Base URL first
sites.apiKeyRequired: Please fill in API Key first
sites.claudeAuthHint: Only affects Claude Code; ignored for Codex
sites.modelListFetchFailed: Could not fetch the model list
sites.modelListUnauthorized: Authentication failed; check the API key or site protocol
sites.modelListFetchRetry: Try again or check the site configuration
sites.noModels: No models yet — fetch or add manually
sites.testNoKey: This site has no API key
sites.clearModelsConfirm: Clear all models in this list?
sites.clearModelsHint: Only clears the local list. You can fetch from upstream again.
sites.deleteSelectedModelsHint: Only removes them from the local list. You can fetch from upstream again.
sites.cleanupTargets: Also clean managed config from target CLIs
sites.cleanupTargetsHint: If unchecked, target config remains as orphan
sites.urlPreviewEmpty: Enter a valid Base URL to preview write targets
sites.enabledHint: Enabled: included in balance refresh and shown in the floating window
sites.disabledHint: Disabled: no balance refresh, hidden from the floating window, cannot be applied
sites.disableAppliedHint: This site is applied to {{targets}}. Clear those app configs as well?
sites.disableClearedSuccess: Site disabled and related app configs cleared
sites.deepLinkUpdatedKey: Site already exists; API key updated
sites.deepLinkAddedKey: Site already exists; a new API key was added
sites.deepLinkActivatedKey: Switched to the imported API key
sites.deepLinkNeedKey: This link has no API key — finish it in the form
sites.deepLinkSecurityHint: Only import trusted links to avoid leaving keys in browser history
sites.quotaNoteOpenCodeGo: OpenCode Go usage is read with the site's own API key — no NewAPI access token or user ID needed.
sites.quotaNoteModelscope: ModelScope inference and Magicube balance share one API token — no NewAPI access token or user ID needed.
sites.newapiTokenHint: Optional. For new-api style relays when standard quota endpoints are unavailable; fetches account balance (generate in personal settings).
sites.newapiTokenSavedHint: Stored encrypted; leave empty and save to clear it.
sites.newapiTokenLoadFailed: Failed to decrypt the access token; this save will not change it.
sites.newapiUserIdHint: Used together with the access token (user ID in personal settings).
sites.newapiTestMissingCredentials: Fill in the access token and user ID first
sites.newapiTestMissingBaseUrl: Fill in the base URL first
sites.proxyHeadersHint: These headers only apply when the local proxy is enabled in settings. Client headers are preserved by default; entries here add or override matching keys.
sites.proxyHeadersPlaceholders: Placeholders: ${API_KEY} (site's active key), ${SESSION} (stable per site, good for session affinity), ${UUID} (new per request).

apply.title: Apply Center
apply.defaultModelHint: Writes the top-level model in settings.json; /model can still switch and save it in Claude Code
apply.codexModelHint: Writes the model field in config.toml
apply.restoreOfficialClaudeHint: Removes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and relay model overrides from settings.json so Claude Code uses the official claude.ai login. Official credentials are kept. Current files are backed up first.
apply.restoreOfficialCodexHint: Removes the relay provider, openai_base_url, and the catalog this app wrote from config.toml, and clears injected XIAOBAI_* environment variables so Codex uses the official ChatGPT login. auth.json is kept. Current files are backed up first.
apply.restoreOfficialClaudeOk: Cleared the Claude Code relay config. You can sign in with the official account.
apply.restoreOfficialCodexOk: Cleared the Codex relay config. You can sign in with the official ChatGPT account.
apply.revertConfirmHint: Removes config written by this app. The CLI will show as not applied.
apply.cleanupConfirmHint: Deletes leftover writes that no longer match a site.
apply.openPathFailed: Could not open the config path
apply.resultPiOk: Wrote Pi models.json, auth.json, and settings.json.
apply.resultPrimeOk: Wrote Prime models.json, auth.json, and settings.json.
apply.failedHint: Could not write the target config. Check status and try again.
apply.restartHint: Restart your terminal or CLI tool for changes to take effect.
apply.noSite: Add and select a site first
apply.noEnabledSite: No enabled sites — enable one in Sites first
apply.modelMapHint: Map Claude Code’s built-in opus / sonnet / haiku / fable aliases to site model ids; custom ids display as Custom <family> model by default and are still mapped
apply.context1mHint: Append the [1m] declaration to the default model and Opus / Sonnet aliases. The model and gateway must actually support 1M context
apply.effortHint: Sets the default effort; /effort can still change and save it in Claude Code, while Max is session-only
apply.writeAllModels: Write all site models into Codex
apply.writeAllModelsHint: Generates a model catalog so you can switch models inside Codex
apply.catalogModelCount: {{count}} models will be written to the catalog
apply.piWriteAllModels: Write all site models into Pi
apply.piWriteAllModelsHint: When off, only the default model is written. Turn it on to switch with Pi’s /model command.
apply.thinkingDefaultHint: Writes defaultThinkingLevel for new sessions. Leave as Unchanged to keep the client value. Off only disables default thinking; it does not remove model reasoning.
apply.thinkingAdvancedHint: Leave empty to omit that extended level. Change the default level before removing a mapping in use.
apply.thinkingAdaptiveHint: Required on Pi Anthropic before xhigh / max can be used
apply.thinkingNeedReasoning: Enable thinking on the default model before choosing a default level
apply.thinkingNeedMapping: Set the provider value for that extended level before using it as the default
apply.thinkingNeedAdaptive: Enable Adaptive thinking on the default model for Pi Anthropic
apply.thinkingPrimeAnthropicNoExtended: Prime Anthropic does not support xhigh / max
apply.removePiConfirm: Remove the XiaoBaiSwitch Plus config from Pi?
apply.removePiHint: Only the managed provider and its API key are removed. Other custom providers, OAuth logins, and unknown settings are preserved. Current files are backed up first.
apply.removePiDone: Removed the managed Pi provider and restored the pre-apply defaults when it was safe to do so.
apply.primeWriteAllModels: Write all site models into Prime
apply.primeWriteAllModelsHint: When off, only the default model is written. Turn it on to switch with Prime’s /model command.
apply.removePrimeConfirm: Remove the XiaoBaiSwitch Plus config from Prime?
apply.removePrimeHint: Only the managed provider and its API key are removed. Other custom providers, OAuth logins, and unknown settings are preserved. Current files are backed up first. The plaintext key is written to ~/.prime/agent/auth.json.
apply.removePrimeDone: Removed the managed Prime provider and restored the pre-apply defaults when it was safe to do so.
apply.reasoningHint: Written to Codex config.toml; only affects models that support reasoning
apply.remoteCompactionHint: Send long-session compaction to the current site. Most relays do not support this — leave it off. When on, the provider display name is written as OpenAI (the condition Codex uses to allow remote compaction); when off, the site name is restored.
apply.imageUnderstandingHint: Allow Codex to send local images to the model. Turn this off for text-only relays. If you also write the model catalog, entries will declare text + image.
apply.imageGenerationHint: Allow Codex to use the built-in image generation tool. Most relays do not support it — leave it off. Independent of image understanding.
apply.webSearchHint: Allow Codex to use the built-in web_search tool. Turn this off if the site rejects that tool, or requests will fail.
apply.capabilityFollowHint: Use the Codex-specific capability switches saved on the site. Editing the site updates the next apply.
apply.capabilityCustomHint: Override the site presets for this apply only. This is not written back to the site.
apply.noBackupsHint: Applying config backs up the current files. Retention is configured in Settings.
apply.restoreBackupConfirmHint: This overwrites the current config files with the backup. The current files will be replaced and cannot be undone.
apply.deleteBackupConfirmHint: This cannot be undone. Only continue if you no longer need this backup.
apply.restoreBackupSuccess: Backup restored. Current config was overwritten.
apply.backupPreviewFailed: Could not read the backup summary

settings.title: Settings
settings.proxySystemHint: Uses the OS proxy. PAC files are not evaluated; if only a PAC is configured, HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY env vars are used as fallback.
settings.probeTtlHint: Opening the route dropdown re-probes URLs older than this. Default is 10 minutes.
settings.autoStartFailed: Could not register launch at login. Check system permissions and try again.
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps the app running in the menu bar / tray. Choose Quit from the tray to exit.
settings.startInTrayHint: Only available when minimize-to-tray is on. Useful with launch at login.
settings.startInTrayDisabled: Turn on "Minimize to tray on close" first
settings.floatingWindowEnabledHint: Display a floating window on the desktop to view site balances in real-time
settings.pathPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the target's default config directory
settings.forceExclusiveAuthHint: When on, deletes the other auth field (API_KEY / AUTH_TOKEN)
settings.maxBackupCopiesHint: Default is 30; oldest copies of each type are removed when the limit is exceeded

backupCenter.loadFailed: Could not load local backup information
backupCenter.localDeleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and cannot be undone

settings.checkUpdateDesktopOnly: Check for updates in the desktop app
settings.noUpdate: You are on the latest version
settings.checkUpdateFailed: Failed to check for updates, please try again later
settings.securityBody: API keys are encrypted in-app. After apply they are written in plaintext to Claude settings.json, codex.env, ~/.pi/agent/auth.json, or ~/.prime/agent/auth.json. Do not sync ~/.xiaobai-switch, ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.pi, or ~/.prime to untrusted cloud storage.
settings.plaintextPaths: Paths that may contain plaintext secrets

webdav.title: WebDAV application backup
webdav.securityWarningTitle: Remote archives include the master key needed to decrypt credentials
webdav.securityWarningBody: Sync bundles contain the app database and the master.key (decryption key): anyone with a bundle can decrypt the API keys inside. Use only a WebDAV service and account you trust. A local snapshot is taken automatically before applying cloud data.
webdav.passwordSavedHint: The password is stored encrypted; leave this blank to keep it unchanged
webdav.invalidCertWarning: This skips server certificate checks and may expose the WebDAV password and backup contents; enable it only when you fully trust the network and server
webdav.loadFailed: Could not load WebDAV backup information
webdav.backupFailed: Could not create the application backup
webdav.cleanupWarning: The backup was uploaded, but old remote backups could not be pruned; check them later
webdav.restoreConfirmBody: A safety snapshot of current application data will be created first, then "{{name}}" will be verified and restored; the app will restart, and Claude/Codex configuration will not be overwritten automatically
webdav.restoreApplied: Application data restored; review target status and reapply configurations manually if needed
webdav.restoreFailed: Application data could not be restored; existing data was preserved, see the application log for details
webdav.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and cannot be undone
webdav.quickSecurityWarning: Bundles contain the decryption master key; use a trusted WebDAV account.
webdav.syncUploadSuccess: Latest local config synced to WebDAV (revision {{revision}})
webdav.syncInSync: Cloud and local data are already in sync
webdav.syncConflictApplied: Conflict detected: a local snapshot was kept and the latest cloud data was applied; roll back from local backups if needed
webdav.algorithmMismatch: Sync paused: the other device uses a different data fingerprint algorithm (its app version is too old). Upgrade that device to the latest version and retry; nothing was uploaded or downloaded, and both sides keep their data.
webdav.intervalExtra: Changes sync immediately; this interval is only a fallback safety net.
webdav.retentionExtra: Recent bundles kept per device on the cloud for rollback.
webdav.syncNote: Changes sync immediately; opening XiaoBaiSwitch Plus on another machine pulls the latest data automatically.

skills.title: Skills Management
skills.empty: No skills yet; install one from a URL or the marketplace

onboarding.welcomeDesc: Three steps to configure an AI upstream site for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or Prime.

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.emptyDesc: Add MCP servers, select target clients, and apply them to Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or Prime.
mcp.name: Server name
mcp.deleteCleansTargets: Deleting also removes this server's managed entries from the client configs it was applied to.
mcp.configHint: Written to client configs as-is; fill in the fields each client supports.
mcp.nameRule: Only letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens
mcp.secretsNotice: Environment variables and headers are encrypted in this app; applying writes them in plaintext to the target client config files (~/.claude.json, config.toml, mcp.json, settings.json). Make sure those files stay private.
mcp.registryTitle: Install from the official MCP registry
mcp.registryDesc: Search the official MCP registry; picking an entry fills in the launch command, so you only add the required secrets. Common servers are listed below by default.
mcp.registryLocalOnlyHint: Show only MCP servers that run on your own machine, so requests never go to a third-party server.
mcp.registryUnsupported: This entry has no usable install method
mcp.registryInstalled: Config loaded from the official registry — fill in the required fields, then save
mcp.registryRequiredTitle: This MCP server needs the following from you
mcp.registryRequiredMissing: Fill in the required fields listed above first
mcp.registrySourceHint: Entries come from the official MCP registry; verify the source before installing.
mcp.manualAddHint: Custom or private MCP servers (when the registry has nothing)
mcp.extraConfigHint: Extra fields beyond command/args/url (JSON object), written to client configs as-is.
mcp.headersStdioHint: Locally run MCP servers usually need no headers.
mcp.updateAllConfirm: Update {{count}} MCP servers to the latest version?
mcp.existingTitle: MCP servers already in your other clients
mcp.existingDesc: Bring over MCP servers you configured by hand in Claude Code, Codex, Pi or Prime — then they sync across devices and can be reused in other clients.
mcp.existingEmpty: No hand-configured MCP servers found in the other clients
mcp.existingNote: Importing stores existing API keys and config encrypted in this app's database (only on your own machine and your WebDAV). The original client config is left untouched.
mcp.applyPanelDesc: Select the clients to write to. Cleanup after rename, disable, or delete only removes managed entries with the xiaobai_ prefix; your own entries are never touched.
mcp.applyCleanupNote: Old managed entries (xiaobai_ prefix) under unchecked targets will be cleaned up; your own entries are kept

rules.title: Global Rules
rules.subtitle: Write once, and it is pushed to each selected agent's user-level instruction file for all future sessions.
rules.placeholder:
# Global rules

- Always answer in Chinese
- Run the tests before claiming a change is done
- Never run git push automatically
rules.emptyMeansClear: An empty body or no selected target removes what this app wrote from each file; your own content is left untouched.
rules.saveAppliesImmediately: Saving writes to the selected targets immediately.
rules.codexShadowDesc: Found {{path}}. Codex only reads this override file, so the AGENTS.md written by this app will not take effect. Decide yourself whether to remove it.
rules.plaintextNotice: The rules are written to those files in plain text, readable by any program that can open them. Each client reads them at startup (Pi/Prime can reload with /reload).

proxy.title: Local proxy
proxy.subtitle: Route client requests through this machine so the proxy can add site-level headers before forwarding upstream.
proxy.pathTokenHint: The token only exists to build takeover URLs and is always shown truncated.
proxy.portHint: Changing the port takes effect after the proxy restarts.
proxy.portSaved: Port saved; if running, the proxy restarts and takeover addresses are rewritten.
proxy.stoppedHint: The proxy is not running. Taken-over targets cannot send requests until you start it.
proxy.takeoverHintDetail: When enabled, the target's Base URL points at this local proxy; disabling writes the site's real address back. Quitting the app restores direct connections.
proxy.takeoverNeedsRunning: Start the proxy before enabling takeover.
proxy.disableAllTitle: Restore every target to a direct connection?
proxy.disableAllBody: All taken-over targets will be written back to their site's real address and stop using the local proxy.
proxy.logPrivacy: The log records method, path, status and duration only — never headers, bodies, keys, or the path token.
proxy.stopRestored: Proxy stopped and taken-over targets were restored to direct connections.
